name: app-dark-fitness-profile-with-blurred-portrait-screens
title: Fitness profiles with moody purple-blur portraits and grey glass rows
whatItIs: A black board titled 'Personal Fitness Profile' with three phones. Each screen is a purple-to-mauve gradient over a dramatic portrait (a face in shadow, hair and headphones, a silhouette of a head) with white text, small tag chips and translucent rows for cost, duration and earnings.
whatItMeans: Intimate and cinematic; the fading portrait makes a fitness app feel like a fashion editorial.
techniques: Let a dark portrait fade into a gradient that carries the UI.
Set text as white on translucent grey glass rows.
Use small chips for attributes such as role and sport.
Anchor with a single white button.
Give the presentation black staging with tiny corner labels.

vocabulary.definition: A photo dissolving into a colour gradient.
A translucent list row over an image.
A small label listing a trait.
An interface treated like a film still.
